description: StudySphere semantic information registry and task taxonomy. Derived from firmware/firmware.ino, alatnya cu/studysphere_esp32.ino, desktop/ui/index.html, README.md and draft.pdf.

temperature.notes: DHT11 on the room node, DHT22 on the station. Rounded to 0.1 C by firmware.

humidity.notes: Same DHT read as temperature; marginal sensing cost is zero once temperature is read.

lighting.notes: Room node exposes lux. The station exposes a bright/dark level plus a raw LDR value; treat it as bright/dark, not lux.

air_quality.notes: Node: good/stale derived from estimated CO2. Station: good/moderate/poor/warmup from the MQ-135 on the UNO. MQ-135 is not a true CO2 sensor.

co2.notes: Estimated from MQ-135, not a calibrated NDIR CO2 measurement. Only the room node exposes this name.

occupancy.notes: Node: PIR with a 60 s idle timeout. Station: HC-SR04 presence within PRESENCE_CM.

session_duration.notes: Seconds since the current study session started; 0 when nobody is present.

mh_sensor.notes: Digital LDR module output on the UNO. The station's lighting object also carries this signal.

lamp.notes: Current lamp output, already present in telemetry; no sensing needed.

lamp_mode.notes: Current lamp mode. Auto turns the lamp on when someone is present and lighting < 150 lux.

fan.notes: Station fan state; reported on the state topic.

vent.notes: Station servo angle; open is about 180, closed about 0.

tasks.room_status: Report one or more concrete readings or device states.
tasks.study_environment_assessment: Judge whether the room is suitable for studying.
tasks.thermal_comfort_check: Judge temperature and, when relevant, humidity comfort.
tasks.air_quality_check: Judge air freshness or report CO2 / MQ-135 level.
tasks.lighting_check: Judge whether the desk is bright enough or whether the lamp should be on.
tasks.occupancy_check: Report whether someone is present or how long the study session has run.
tasks.study_break_advice: Decide whether the student should take a break.
tasks.ventilation_decision: Decide whether to open a window or the station vent.
tasks.energy_saving_check: Check for wasted energy, e.g. lamp or fan on with nobody present.
tasks.lamp_control: Change the room node lamp mode.
tasks.vent_control: Open or close the station vent.
tasks.lcd_message: Show a short message on the 16x2 LCD.
tasks.general_chat: Greeting, thanks, or chit-chat that needs no sensor reading.
